instruction: Implement parse_date(text) in dates.py. Accept three formats: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY and 'Month D, YYYY' where Month is the English full month name. Return the date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Raise ValueError for any other input. Run `python3 test_dates.py`; do not edit the tests. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the word DONE to answer.txt.
